title: Online Orders Quick Card — Cancellation Window and Change Limits
content:
**Cancellation window:** the minutes after placement during which an Online Orders order stays in status placed and can be cancelled or edited.

| Delivery service | Cancellation window (minutes after placement) | Shipping address changeable | Delivery service changeable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 30 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 30 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |
| Standard Ground | 30 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |
| Expedited 2-Day | 30 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |
| Next Business Day | 30 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |
| Same-Day Courier | 15 | Only while the order is in status placed | Only while the order is in status placed |

**Reading the card**

- Same-Day Courier is the one service with the shorter window, 15 minutes; every other service has 30 minutes.
- For every service, both the shipping address and the delivery service can be changed only while the order is in status placed.

**Illustration (hypothetical times, Eastern Time)**

| Service | Placed at | Window runs for | In status placed, cancellation window open until |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ground | 09:10 | 30 minutes | 09:40 |
| Same-Day Courier | 09:10 | 15 minutes | 09:25 |
